releaseNotes:
📸 Photo & Instagram Reels URL Preservation Release (v1.2.3) by Dhiraj:
• 📸 Full Conversation Photo Saving: Fixed issue where Instagram DM photos were discarded; all received chat photos are now reliably captured and preserved in conversation history.
• 🎬 Direct Instagram Reels URLs: Captures direct Instagram Reel links (including share links, deep links, and FCM payloads) with preview thumbnails.
• 🛡️ Enhanced InboxStyle Media Extraction: Multi-message and grouped notifications now discover and link photos, videos, and voice notes.
• 🔒 Privacy & Security: Developer dashboard removed from public repository; strictly private and offline.
• 💬 WhatsApp-Style Persistent Conversations: 1 persistent chat box per person and group chat with chronological order.
